Commentary.Commentary: The Irish players have made their way out to the middle. Max O'Dowd and Stephan Myburgh are the openers for Netherlands. Barry McCarthy to start with the ball.
...The Run Chase...

The target is somewhat similar to what Ireland changed easily a few days ago. It will be interesting to see if the wicket does get better like the last time but if it does not, 164 could well be a challenging score as it is a pretty tough surface to bat on. Stay tuned for the chase in a bit.

Tector and Dockrell then added just below 90 to take their team to safer shores but once Dockrell fell, the procession began and they kept losing wickets at regular intervals. At one stage they seemed like getting over 200 but they have fallen well short.
It was Klaassen who started things off by getting Kevin in the first over. Klaassen then got Stirling and Balbirnie also followed soon. The visitors were in trouble at 28 for 3.
End of a really good bowling performance from the hosts. Their skipper will be pretty pleased after he was asked to field.

OUT! RUN OUT! With this Ireland lose their final wicket. Young is eager to change the strike and loses his wicket in the process. Good length ball, on off, Young defends it onto the pitch. As he ventures out for a non-existant run. The bowler does really well on his followthrough as he sees the batsman out of his crease and he dives forward to pick up the ball and strike the stumps. A loud appeal, as the umpire takes it to the third umpire. The replays show that Young is outside the crease by a margin and is a goner.
A run out appeal and it is referred upstairs. Young seems short.

OUT! LBW! Josh Little departs with just a run. Logan van Beek gets his third now. The bowlers have done a great job here for the Netherlands. Serves a length ball, on the pads, Little looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads. A loud appeal for LBW and the umpire raises his finger. Little does not review and we wonder why? That seemed to be heading down leg and looking at the replays, it indeed seems like it would have gone down leg. Also, Ultra Edge shows a spike.

Commentary.Howout: c Pieter Seelaar b Fred Klaassen

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Stirling gets the first boundary of the game. A lenght ball, outside off, offered some  width to Paul Stirling and he cuts it thorugh cover-point for a boundary.
WIDE! Back of a length delivery, down the leg side, Stirling leaves it alone. Wide given.
A length ball, on off, Andy Balbirnie defends it back to the bowler.
A touch fuller, on off, Andy Balbirnie plays it to mid on.
A length ball, on off, Stirling pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Serves a length ball, around off, Stirling drives it to mid off.
A length ball, on off, Stirling blocks it to cover.
On a length, on off, Paul Stirling defends it solidly.
Who will bowl from the other end? Kingma it is, back into the side can he strike early?
Good length outside off, Andy Balbirnie pushes it to cover.
A length ball, on off, Andy Balbirnie plays it back to the bowler.
Balbirnie walks out to bat!

OUT! TIMBER! Kevin O'Brien goes for a duck. Not the start he wanted for himself and surely not the start Ireland would have wanted after electing to bat. Fred Klaassen finds the breakthrough via a peach of a delivery. A length ball, on middle and leg, Kevin O'Brien looks to defend it but completely misses. As the ball finds the gap and goes through the bat and pad to disturb the stumps. That came in really nicely. Good start for Netherlands.
A length ball, on off, nudged to mid-wicket.

A full delivery, on middle and leg, Kevin looks to flick it to the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. A loud appeal for LBW turned down. Probably pitched just outside leg and replays show that it indeed does.
Klassen starts with a length ball, on off, Kevin O'Brien pushes it to cover.
We are all set for the action to begin then. Paul Stirling and Kevin O'Brien to open for the first time in the series. Klaassen to open the bowling for the Dutch.

NETHERLANDS (PLAYING XI) - Max ODowd, Stephan Myburgh, Musa Ahmed (in place of Saqib Zulfiqar), Ben Cooper, Pieter Seelaar (C), Bas de Leede, Scott Edwards (WK), Logan van Beek, Timm van der Gugten, Fred Klaassen, Vivian Kingma (in place of Brandon Glover).

IRELAND (PLAYING XI) - Paul Stirling, Kevin O'Brien (in place of William Porterfield), Andrew Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector, George Dockrell, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Simi Singh, Andy McBrine, Barry McCarthy, Joshua Little, Craig Young
TOSS - The coin goes up and falls in the favour of Ireland. THEY WILL BAT FIRST!

It is time for the decider, the third and the final game of the ODI series between Netherlands and Ireland. The series is at stake, the winner takes it all. Ireland have momentum on their side after a strong comeback in the last game. Netherlands on the other hand, will be eager to put in a better show and seal the series. An exciting encounter awaits. Stay tuned for the toss and teams.
